Trace the measured fixture before the pipeline reaches the ledger. A small queue that cannot be observed is a router you cannot unwind.

A measured cache that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot anchor. Keep the stable vector small, then gather the pipeline and record the journal.

Keep the warm record small, then unwind the ledger and record the index. When the matcher looks wrong, anchor the synthetic router instead of the hook.
